Can I add an item to an order I already placed?
For regular orders, Happy Wax’s shipping policy states that orders can’t be canceled or changed once they’re placed. This means you won’t be able to add an item to your order after checkout.
The one exception is for subscription orders that haven’t processed yet. In the subscription portal, you can add one-time add-ons or update your box for an upcoming shipment, and then click Save Changes.
If you’d like help with a specific order, just log in and I can check whether it’s a subscription order or a regular placed order.
